spec: §15 suite B (stack exhaustion, sp + R_f > stack_limit); §3.7: lift.call flag = (depth+1 > depth_limit) or (sp + R_f > stack_limit), C = FAULT_BUDGET_DEPTH; §16.3: R_sum = 16 cells
derivation: n=1 makes two nested calls occupying 16 and then 32 cells; with stack_limit 31 the first call fits (sp 0+16) and the recursive call at row 16 (row count of B-call-step-reversal) has sp+R_f = 32 > 31: (0,3) in 16 steps.
